title: In a Little While We're Going Home
lyrics: Verse 1:
[D]Let us sing a song [G]that will [D]cheer us by [Em]the [D]way,
In a little while we're going [A]home;
For the [A7]night will end in the [D]everlasting day,
Refrain:
In a [Em]little while we're [D]going home.
Verse 2:
In a [A7]little while, In a [D]little while,
We [Em]shall [D]cross the [A7]billow's [A]foam;
[D]We [Em]shall [D]meet at last, [Em]When the [G]stormy winds are past,
Refrain:
[E7]In a [D]little [Em]while we're [D]going home.
Verse 3:
We will do the work that our hands may find to do,
In a little while we're going home.
And the grace of God will our daily strength renew,
Refrain:
In a little while we're going home.
Verse 4:
We will smooth the path for some weary, wayworn feet,
In a little while we're going home.
And may loving hearts spread around an influence sweet!
Refrain:
In a little while we're going home.
Verse 5:
There's a rest beyond, there's relief from every care,
In a little while we're going home;
And no tears shall fall in that city bright and fair,
Refrain:
In a little while we're going home.
